name: Chicken Caesar Salad
blurb: Crisp romaine, garlicky anchovy dressing, croutons and grilled chicken.
ingredients: Dressing: 4 anchovy fillets, 1 garlic clove, 1 egg yolk, 1 tsp Dijon, juice of half a lemon, 6 tbsp olive oil, 20g grated Parmesan
method: Toss the bread with oil and bake at 200C fan for 10 minutes until crisp.
Season and griddle the chicken for 5-6 minutes each side, then rest and slice.
Blitz or whisk the dressing ingredients to a smooth, pourable sauce.
Toss the lettuce with most of the dressing, then top with chicken, croutons and Parmesan.

name: Halloumi, Grain & Pomegranate Bowl
blurb: Griddled halloumi over lemony grains with herbs and pomegranate.
ingredients: Big handful each parsley and mint, chopped
Zest and juice of 1 lemon, 4 tbsp olive oil
method: Toss the warm grains with the lemon, oil, herbs and sumac; season.
Griddle the halloumi for 1-2 minutes each side until bar-marked.
Fold the pomegranate and walnuts through the grains.
Top with the hot halloumi and a final scatter of sumac.

name: Salade Niçoise
blurb: Seared tuna, green beans, new potatoes, egg, olives and a sharp dressing.
ingredients: Dressing: 6 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 small garlic clove, few basil leaves
method: Boil the potatoes until tender; add the beans for the last 3 minutes. Drain and cool slightly.
Soft-boil the eggs for 6-7 minutes, then peel and halve.
Sear the tuna in a very hot pan for 1 minute each side so it stays pink; slice.
Whisk the dressing. Arrange everything on a platter and spoon the dressing over.

name: Salmon Poke Bowl
blurb: Marinated raw salmon over rice with edamame, avocado, cucumber and sesame.
ingredients: 300g very fresh skinless salmon fillet, diced
200g sushi rice, cooked and cooled slightly
Marinade: 2 tbsp soy, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp honey, pinch of chilli flakes
2 spring onions, sesame seeds, pickled ginger to serve
method: Mix the marinade and gently fold through the salmon; leave 10 minutes.
Divide the rice between bowls.
Arrange the salmon, edamame, avocado and cucumber on top.
Finish with spring onions, sesame and pickled ginger.

name: Greek Chicken Souvlaki Bowl
blurb: Lemon-oregano chicken with rice, tzatziki, tomato-cucumber salad and olives.
ingredients: Marinade: juice of 1 lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp dried oregano, 3 garlic cloves
Tzatziki: 300g yoghurt, half a grated and squeezed cucumber, 1 garlic clove, splash of vinegar
Salad: 3 tomatoes, half a cucumber, half a red onion, chopped
method: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes, then thread on skewers.
Cook the rice. Mix the tzatziki and the chopped salad separately.
Grill or griddle the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked.
Build bowls with rice, chicken, salad, tzatziki, olives and crumbled feta.

name: Peanut Tofu Buddha Bowl
blurb: Crisp baked tofu, brown rice, raw veg and a lime-peanut dressing.
ingredients: 450g firm tofu, cubed and tossed with 2 tbsp cornflour and soy
Dressing: 3 tbsp peanut butter, juice of 1 lime, 1 tbsp soy, 1 tsp maple, 1 tsp grated ginger, water to loosen
method: Bake the tofu at 200C fan for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
Cook the rice.
Whisk the dressing until pourable.
Build bowls with rice, raw veg, edamame and tofu, then drizzle generously with the peanut dressing.

name: Pork Larb Lettuce Cups
blurb: Zingy Thai minced pork with lime, chilli, herbs and toasted rice, in lettuce.
ingredients: 2 tbsp uncooked rice, toasted and ground
Juice of 3 limes, 3 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tsp sugar
Big handful each mint and coriander
method: Cook the pork in a dry hot pan with a splash of water, breaking it small, until just done.
Off the heat, add the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chilli.
Stir through the shallots, spring onions, herbs and toasted rice powder.
Spoon into lettuce cups to eat with your hands.

name: Roast Veg & Feta Quinoa Salad
blurb: Warm roasted vegetables through herby quinoa with feta and a lemon dressing.
ingredients: 1 aubergine, 1 courgette, 1 red pepper, 1 red onion, chopped
Dressing: juice of 1 lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp honey, 1 small garlic clove
method: Toss the vegetables with oil and roast at 200C fan for 25-30 minutes until soft and charred.
Cook the quinoa in salted water for 12-15 minutes, then drain well.
Toss the warm quinoa with the dressing and herbs.
Fold through the roast veg and feta and serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Prawn, Mango & Avocado Salad
blurb: Sweet mango, creamy avocado and prawns with a chilli-lime dressing.
ingredients: 1 baby gem or handful of rocket
Half a red onion, thinly sliced
Dressing: juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp honey, 1 red chilli chopped
method: Whisk the dressing.
Gently combine the prawns, mango, avocado and onion.
Fold through the leaves and coriander.
Dress just before serving so the avocado stays bright.

name: Tuna Panzanella
blurb: Torn sourdough soaked in tomato juices with tuna, capers and red onion.
ingredients: 2 x 160g tins good tuna in oil
5 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar
method: Salt the tomatoes and leave 10 minutes to release their juices.
Soak the onion in the vinegar for 10 minutes.
Toast or griddle the bread, then toss with the tomatoes, onion, oil and capers.
Leave 10 minutes for the bread to soften, then flake in the tuna and tear through the basil.

name: Chopped Italian Salad
blurb: Everything diced small — salami, provolone, chickpeas, peppers, a red wine vinaigrette.
ingredients: Dressing: 5 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp Dijon
method: Whisk the dressing with plenty of black pepper.
Combine all the chopped ingredients in a big bowl.
Toss with the dressing just before serving so it stays crunchy.

name: Seared Steak with Rocket & Parmesan
blurb: Rested sliced steak over peppery rocket with shaved Parmesan and balsamic.
method: Season the steaks well and sear in a smoking-hot pan for 2-3 minutes each side. Rest 5 minutes.
Dress the rocket and tomatoes lightly with oil and a pinch of salt.
Slice the steak against the grain and lay over the leaves.
Shave over the Parmesan and finish with balsamic and any resting juices.

name: Chicken & Bacon Cobb Salad
blurb: A composed salad of chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, blue cheese and tomato.
ingredients: Dressing: 4 tbsp olive oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp honey
method: Lay the lettuce on a platter.
Arrange the chicken, bacon, quartered eggs, sliced avocado, tomatoes and crumbled blue cheese in rows.
Whisk the dressing and pour over just before serving; toss at the table.

name: Black Bean, Corn & Lime Quinoa
blurb: A zesty Tex-Mex bowl of quinoa, black beans, charred corn, avocado and coriander.
ingredients: 300g sweetcorn, charred in a dry pan
Dressing: juice of 2 limes, 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp maple, pinch of chilli
method: Cook the quinoa, drain well and cool slightly.
Char the corn in a hot dry pan until spotty.
Toss the quinoa with the beans, corn, onion and dressing.
Fold through the avocado and coriander just before serving.

name: Smoked Mackerel & Beetroot Salad
blurb: Peppery leaves, sweet beetroot, horseradish crème fraîche and flaked mackerel.
ingredients: 2 smoked mackerel fillets, skin removed and flaked
Dressing: 3 tbsp crème fraîche, 1 tbsp horseradish, squeeze of lemon
method: Loosen the horseradish crème fraîche with a little water to a drizzling consistency.
Pile the leaves, beetroot and apple on plates.
Scatter over the flaked mackerel and hazelnuts.
Spoon over the dressing and add a squeeze more lemon.

name: Caprese Orzo Salad
blurb: Cooled orzo with mozzarella pearls, cherry tomatoes, basil and balsamic.
method: Cook the orzo, drain, rinse briefly under cold water and drain well.
Toss with the oil, balsamic and garlic.
Fold through the tomatoes, mozzarella and torn basil.
Season and serve at room temperature.

name: Falafel & Tahini Salad Bowl
blurb: Baked falafel over chopped salad and hummus with a lemony tahini drizzle.
ingredients: 1 pack ready falafel (or homemade), baked until crisp
Chopped salad: 3 tomatoes, 1 cucumber, half a red onion, handful of parsley
Tahini sauce: 4 tbsp tahini, juice of 1 lemon, 1 small garlic clove, water
method: Heat the falafel through in a 200C oven for 12-15 minutes until crisp.
Whisk the tahini with lemon, garlic and water until creamy and pourable.
Spread hummus in the base of each bowl.
Top with the shredded lettuce, chopped salad, falafel and pickles, then drizzle with tahini.

name: Vietnamese Chicken Noodle Salad (Bun Ga)
blurb: Cold rice vermicelli with lemongrass chicken, herbs, pickled veg and nuoc cham.
ingredients: Marinade: 2 lemongrass stalks minced, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 garlic cloves
1 carrot and half a cucumber, julienned
Big handful each mint, coriander and Thai basil
Nuoc cham: 3 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 chilli, 1 garlic clove, 4 tbsp water
method: Marinate the chicken for 20 minutes, then sear in a hot pan until caramelised and cooked.
Mix the nuoc cham until the sugar dissolves.
Divide the noodles between bowls and top with carrot, cucumber and herbs.
Add the hot chicken, scatter with peanuts and pour over the nuoc cham.

name: Roast Salmon & Broccoli Grain Bowl
blurb: Flaked roast salmon, charred tenderstem, avocado and grains with a green dressing.
ingredients: Dressing: big handful of parsley and basil, 1 small garlic clove, juice of 1 lemon, 5 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp capers
method: Roast the salmon and broccoli (tossed in a little oil) at 200C fan for 12-14 minutes.
Blitz the dressing ingredients to a loose green sauce.
Warm the grains and divide between bowls.
Flake over the salmon, add the broccoli and sliced avocado, and spoon over the green dressing.
